subject.title: [Bug] Feishu: message(action=send) renders card JSON as plain text instead of interactive card (regression)

question: Should the next Feishu plain-message card JSON fix require live Feishu proof before adoption, or may maintainers accept source/test proof for a narrow Feishu-plugin parser?
rationale: The source bug remains clear, but multiple same-shape PRs closed unmerged because after-fix Feishu proof or override was unresolved, so automation should not open another fix branch until the proof bar is chosen.

options.title: Require live Feishu proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or contributor verifies that `message(action=send)` renders the reported JSON as an interactive card in a real Feishu chat.

options.title: Accept source/test proof
options.body: Sponsor or reopen a narrow Feishu-local parser fix with focused channel/outbound tests and treat live Feishu proof as desirable but not required.

options.title: Retire raw JSON auto-detection
options.body: Decide that plain `message` card JSON is no longer supported and update user-facing docs to direct users to structured presentation or channelData paths.

recommendation.title: Require live Feishu proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or contributor verifies that `message(action=send)` renders the reported JSON as an interactive card in a real Feishu chat.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin is documented as community maintained by this handle, making them the best available owner for the Feishu-specific proof and support-boundary choice.
